metadata.notes: Minimal tool entity, added 2026-08-13 so data/actions/mash.json's requiredTools reference resolves — same minimal-tool precedent as knife.json/pan.json/mortar.json. A ricer or fork would produce a real, different texture (ricer: fine and fluffy, no gluten-like gumminess risk; fork: coarser, more variable) — not modeled as separate tools here, same 'built for what's asked, not speculative' discipline as elsewhere in this vocabulary; see mash.json's consistencyNote for the one texture distinction that IS modeled (via a parameter, not a tool choice).
